title: the Rossini Scarlatta (the Chad package car) from the owner's five references, with butterfly doors
lensAText: FIRST open the owner's five references with the Read tool (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/car2/refs-2026-11-16/side.webp, rear.webp, front.webp, top.webp, interior.webp) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/car2/reference-sheet.png: they govern, except that real makers' designs and the pictured gold orbit emblem must NOT be copied (the Rossini R badge in bronze is the placeholder). Then: a sceptical automotive art director for a premium driving game. Look at every side-by-side image the builder cites with the Read tool, then build dist/artifact.html yourself and take your own frames in ONE short Playwright script: the Rossini Scarlatta in the garage/showroom (side, front, rear, three-quarter, with the Doors toggle closed and open), the seat view (setCam('cockpit')) at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 3) and 1280x720 by day and night, a chase frame on the freeway at night, and the Rossini GT and OC Hypercar unchanged. Judge: how close is it to each reference (crimson clear coat, black-glass canopy, blade headlights, bonnet vents, honeycomb front with carbon fins and bronze-edged splitter, side scoop, carbon skirts, the wing on curved posts with crimson end plates, the Y-element oval tail lights, twin oval exhausts, the strake diffuser, bronze ten-spoke wheels with red calipers; the cockpit: burgundy leather, cream perforated seats, carbon, bronze trim, the flat-bottom cream/burgundy wheel, the cluster, the centre screen line drawing, bronze knobs and toggles, the red flip-cover start switch, warm ambient lines)? Do the BUTTERFLY DOORS look and move right (hinged at the A-pillar, up and forward with an outward tilt, >= 70 degrees, inner door cards and sill visible, smooth strut-like easing, both sides, within a stall's width)? Is it locked behind the pack in the garage and unlocked by the test unlock? Name the biggest remaining differences, ranked. Reject on: a real maker's badge or a copied identifiable real-car design, doors that clip through the body or ground, other cars changed, broken budgets on the phone.
brief: Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/wf/brief-scarlatta.md in full FIRST and follow it; it is the brief (the owner's five references, the brand rules, the butterfly doors, the interior, tiers and budgets, the pack lock, the tune, what not to edit, and the proof).
